canonical_program:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (apply-transform grid cmd)
      (cond [(= cmd 0) grid]
            [(= cmd 1) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= cmd 2) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= cmd 3) (transpose grid)]
            [(= cmd 4) (flip-lr grid)]
            [else (flip-ud grid)]))
    (define (split-blank-cols grid)
      (let loop ([c 0] [panels (list)])
        (cond [(>= c (cols grid)) (reverse panels)]
              [(all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c) 0)) (range 0 (rows grid)))
               (loop (+ c 1) panels)]
              [else
               (let scan ([stop c])
                 (if (or (>= stop (cols grid))
                         (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r stop) 0)) (range 0 (rows grid))))
                     (loop (+ stop 1)
                           (cons (subgrid grid 0 c (- (rows grid) 1) (- stop 1)) panels))
                     (scan (+ stop 1))))])))
    (let* ((select-idx (at g 0 0))
           (cmd (at g 0 1))
           (body (subgrid g 1 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))
           (panel (crop-to-content (nth (split-blank-cols body) (- select-idx 1)))))
      (apply-transform panel cmd))))
finding: The three visible demonstrations use only commands 4, 4, and 0. A rival that interprets unseen command 2 as rotate-cw instead of rotate-180 fits every demonstration but changes the query.
recommended_repair: Assemble lessons so every query command is demonstrated on an asymmetric selected panel, or explicitly constrain/admit command-map alternatives rather than relying on an unseen numeric code.
